data.description:
## Context / Problem

038d must convert eight live env/config aliases from warn+map behavior into explicit removed-input handling and move all runtime/test consumers to canonical spellings. The single-leaf plan review found that this work spans more than the five originally named functional consumers: it also includes the dedicated alias-behavior suites, the read-freshness opt-out test, the `RECONCILER_ABSENT_GET_BUDGET` functional consumers, the config-surface render path, and source-level guidance that still describes the old spellings as live aliases.

## Approach

After the ADR child merges, replace the eight `_permanent(...)` alias rows with the approved tombstone/removal behavior in `_deprecations.py`, remove the active parsing/mapping paths from `_config_sources.py`, and remove `verify.overlap_enabled` from `_config_sections._ALIASES`. Update `_commands/show_config.py` and any live runtime/source-docstring consumer that still depends on alias behavior. Migrate all affected tests to canonical spellings where they are functional consumers, and replace dedicated alias-behavior assertions with tombstone failure assertions.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_deprecations.py`, `src/rebar/_config_sources.py`, `src/rebar/_config_sections.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/show_config.py`
- live alias/source-docstring consumers such as `src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py`, `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/rebar_id_audit.py`, `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_differ.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/compact.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/_init.py`, and `src/rebar/llm/build_drift.py`
- alias-behavior suites: `tests/unit/test_config_sync_aliases.py`, `tests/unit/test_config_ev3a_aliases.py`, `tests/unit/test_config_alias_overlap_rename.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_ev3c_env_renames.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_config_file_wiring.py`
- functional consumers migrated to canonical names: `tests/integration/test_store_concurrency.py`, `tests/interfaces/queries/test_next_batch_compute.py`, `tests/interfaces/store/test_bridge_preview_under_sync_contention_heldout.py`, `tests/unit/test_read_freshness_parity.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conflict/test_conflict_resolver_no_rebar_id_writes.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_rebar_id_label_writers.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_differ_bound_but_absent.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_outbound_differ_bound_but_absent.py`, and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_get_rotation_heldout.py`

## Testing

Write RED-first coverage proving each removed spelling now fails loudly with the canonical replacement in the error message, then migrate/replace the alias-behavior and functional-consumer tests so they pass only on the canonical spellings. Prove the canonical values keep the prior typed behavior for sync pull, compact threshold, scratch base dir, Jira CLI timeout, deletion probe limit, unsafe ID guard bypass, and duplicate-ticket suggestion.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The eight removed spellings are no longer active alias parsers/mappers and are represented only by the approved removed-input/tombstone behavior.
- [ ] `verify.overlap_enabled` is removed from live alias enrollment and the config-surface render path behaves correctly once the old key is retired.
- [ ] Dedicated alias-behavior suites are updated from warn+map expectations to removed-input expectations.
- [ ] All functional consumers of the eight removed spellings use canonical inputs instead, including read-freshness and deletion-probe-budget paths.
- [ ] Canonical config/env spellings still preserve the prior typed behavior and precedence rules they replace.
